branches.conclusion: Official About page establishes Microsoft as the corporate technology employer, not a university business school. Corporate business functions and education products are not university doctoral programmes.
Microsoft engineering/research employment and developer/education tools belong to a company. No independent university engineering doctoral provider is asserted for this source record.

sources.note: Entire official About page read: corporate mission and values, products, developer tools, company careers and education products. Existing corporation exclusion reaffirmed, not converted into an academic provider.

limitations: Corporate employer record remains appropriate for placement/employment histories. This is an entity-type scope exclusion, not an audit of externally awarded degrees, university collaborations or employees doctoral qualifications.
